notes.title: Release, bugs reports and other things
notes.content:
Hello everyone

So, the day was gone since we are released. We are receive a lot of bug reports, news and wishes (not all is positive, but the game is not completed). We are was expect some of them. Also we are keep some questions and want to share all this information with you.

Questions which you are asking often:
1. No this is not a Prison Architect about movies. Yes we have some similar things. But it may if the game in similar genres. But we have much more differences in game play & styles.
2. No, we are don't use PA engine or source code.
3. Yes the game will have trading cards, but later.
4. Yes, the game will be localized.
5. Yes, the game will support steam works and other features.
6. We are looking thorough our contact form on a website & will respond to you in any case.

Bugs which we found with your help & starts to fix in nearest feature:
1. Cant building the wall.
2. When you double click new game the game is crashed.
3. When you have 2 or more movies the release list is overlapping.
4. We was had a problem with scenarios, translating, misspells, overlapping. Currently we are rewrite it with help of professional translators.
5. You cant load the game after the some films is released.

What we want to implement in future:
1. Fix bugs, fix, fix, fix. More fixes to the god of fixes.
2. Rename text to images in film episodes section.
3. Starts to adding actor contracts.
4. Keep writing scenarios and translating it. We are have more than 100 scenarios in stash in more than 5 genres. And the more is coming.

Thank you for all of your activity with our game. We are very appreciate it. If you have any bugs or error which don't have in list please share with us in a steam discussion board.

Sincerely yours,
The Tambourine Team
